ctx.x: thing. You remember who else was in the band when your father and uncle were in the band?

In the Renee's band? Let's see who was in the band. There was a banjo player, Chester Jones I know the bass player was in the band. Chester Jones was one and Zeb the Klanet player. Zeb. You might have heard talk about Zeb.
I think Chester Jones the one I know is a drummer. No it was Chester Zarder.
